raw.details:
BuildLab 2026 — Professional Frontend Development Hackathon

Organized by Frontend Arena

About the Event:

BuildLab 2026 is an online frontend development hackathon exclusively designed for working professionals. The competition challenges individual developers to transform a given problem statement into a functional, responsive, and polished web application within a limited timeframe.

The event focuses on modern frontend engineering, AI-assisted development, vibe coding, UI/UX design, and practical product building. Participants can use modern AI coding tools to accelerate development while demonstrating their individual technical skills, creativity, and problem-solving abilities.

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Open exclusively to working professionals.
  • Independent working professionals and freelancers are eligible.
  • Professionals from any industry, organization, or technical specialization may participate.
  • Students who are not currently working professionals are not eligible.
  • Individual participation only.
  • Team registrations and collaborative submissions are not permitted.
  • Each participant must develop and submit their own project.
  • Participants must provide accurate registration and professional details.
  • Organizers may request eligibility verification if necessary.

Competition Format:

  • Mode: Online
  • Participation: Individual only
  • Rounds: One round
  • Duration: 6 continuous hours
  • Problem Statements: One common problem statement for all participants
  • Development Approach: Modern frontend development with AI-assisted coding permitted

Single Round — 6-Hour Individual Build Challenge

At the beginning of the hackathon, participants will receive one common problem statement, its requirements, acceptance criteria, and submission instructions.

Each participant will have six continuous hours to plan, design, develop, test, and deploy an individual solution.

There will be no preliminary qualification round or additional elimination round. All eligible registered participants will compete directly in the same challenge.

After the submission deadline, projects will be evaluated against the published criteria, and the final results will be announced through official Frontend Arena channels.

3. Mandatory Technology Requirements

Using a recognized modern frontend framework is mandatory.

Eligible frameworks include:

  • React.js
  • Next.js
  • Vue.js / Nuxt
  • Angular
  • Svelte / SvelteKit
  • Other comparable modern frontend frameworks, subject to organizer approval.

Participants may use TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, component libraries, design systems, animation libraries, routing solutions, state management tools, and permitted APIs or backend services where appropriate.

AI-Assisted Development and Vibe Coding

  • AI coding assistants and vibe-coding platforms are permitted.
  • Participants may use AI tools to generate, modify, debug, and improve code.
  • Each participant remains responsible for their own submission, including its functionality, correctness, and quality.
  • All required features must be tested before submission.

Important: Projects developed exclusively with plain HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript without a qualifying frontend framework are not eligible. These technologies may be used within a framework-based application.

Submission Requirements:

Every participant must submit:

  • Participant details and project name.
  • A brief description of the solution.
  • A publicly accessible live deployment URL.
  • A source-code repository URL.
  • Setup instructions or supporting documentation, if required.

Participants must submit their own work before the official deadline and ensure that their deployment and repository links remain accessible during evaluation.

Evaluation Criteria:

Submissions will be evaluated against the announced problem statement and its requirements. The assessment may consider:

  • Problem Statement Alignment: Fulfilment of the specified requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Functionality: Completeness of features and working interactions.
  • UI/UX Quality: Visual consistency, usability, responsiveness, and accessibility.
  • Technical Implementation: Framework usage, component structure, and code quality.
  • Creativity and Product Thinking: Originality, usefulness, and thoughtful implementation.
  • Overall Execution: Completeness, reliability, and presentation of the final product.

The official scoring framework and applicable criteria will be communicated before the competition.

Rules and Regulations:

  • Participation is strictly individual; teams and collaborative submissions are not permitted.
  • Only eligible working professionals may participate.
  • Every participant must work on the common problem statement announced by the organizers.
  • The development window is strictly limited to six continuous hours.
  • AI coding assistants and vibe-coding platforms are allowed.
  • A recognized modern frontend framework is mandatory.
  • Plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JavaScript-only projects are not eligible.
  • Participants must submit their own projects before the official deadline.
  • Existing libraries and components may be used in accordance with their licenses and the competition rules.
  • Plagiarism, submitting another person's complete project as one's own, and deceptive claims of authorship are prohibited.
  • Participants must not manipulate results, exploit vulnerabilities, or interfere with other submissions or competition infrastructure.
  • Required submission links must remain accessible during the evaluation period.
  • Organizers may request a demonstration or clarification when necessary.
  • Violations of eligibility requirements or competition rules may result in disqualification.
  • Participants must follow official announcements and instructions issued by Frontend Arena.

Prizes and Certificates:

Prize details, winner announcements, and certificate eligibility will be communicated through the official BuildLab 2026 announcement and communication channels.

Organizer:

BuildLab 2026 is organized by Frontend Arena to provide working professionals with an opportunity to demonstrate their individual frontend engineering skills, experiment with AI-assisted development, and build practical digital products under a strict time limit.

Think. Build. Innovate. Ship.
